Mixed Herb Dressing
By: Cresent
Published: Saturday, December 26, 2009 - 11:12pm

Ingredients




6 tablespoons Olive oil
2 tablespoons Balsamic vinegar
1 tablespoon Chopped parsley, chives and 1 teaspoon Mustard

Preparation

1 Place herbs, vinegar, and mustard in a bowl and whisk together. Slowly drizzle oil into mixture, while whisking. 2 Toss on a green salad, roasted vegetables, or freshly boiled new potatoes.
